## Registry contribution checklist

- [ ] My entry is `registry/clocks/<id>.json` and `python scripts/build_registry.py --check` passes.
- [ ] It contains model parameters and aggregate statistics only: no identifiers, no per-patient values, no per-patient scores.
- [ ] Every group size I report is at least 100 (reference n and n scored).
- [ ] I have the right to share these parameters and I chose a license for the entry.
- [ ] I understand the entry will be shown as self-reported and as research use only.
